cohort: The study participants were Very-Low-Birth-Weight infants, divided into two groups based on their calcium-phosphorus intake.
finding: Nutritional intake of calcium, phosphorus, and protein, as well as gestational age and gender, significantly affected biochemical parameters related to calcium-phosphorus homeostasis in Very-Low-Birth-Weight infants.
birth_weight: Median (IRQ) 948 (772-1225) grams and 939 (776-1163) grams in the respective groups.
gest_age: Median (IRQ) 28.2 (26.5-29.6) weeks and 27.8 (26.1-29.4) weeks in the respective groups.
